_comment: Fast-tier regions (SHARC_FAST_REGIONS) and block-translator cluster roots (SHARC_BLOCKTRANS) verified exact per firmware, and fallback-only roots (SHARC_FAST_FALLBACK_REGIONS), keyed by the SHA-256 of the stock .syx whose DSP they belong to. Fallback-only roots run only when code verification bars their generated entry. Addresses only; not firmware content. Regions: measured A/B 0.958 idle, 0.963 chord16 for the roots (DSP CPU per audio s, non-PGO). Digitakt II 1.17: 0x1c4ed2 is the stock code after the dsp-voice hook returns (not an AOT entry); the fallback roots 0x1c1fe7 and 0x1c204b are barred by the patched words at 0x1c207a. Interpreted instructions per audio s on the dt2-led-sweep runtime replay: 6.0 M with only 0x1c2607, 3.4 M with these; PCM and DSP state equal. The other DT2 1.17 regular roots are seeds for chase (packages/emulator/sharc/src/fast/mod.rs): places where the interpreter resumes after a branch, mostly in the interrupt entry and exit code, the task switch and the block epilogue. A refused seed makes the instruction after it an entry, so one seed covers the straight-line code up to the next branch. Stock dt2-led-sweep, 3 audio s: 5.85 M interpreted instructions with 0x1c4ed2 only, 3.28 M with the seeds; patched runtime: 10.66 M to 8.05 M.
